items.question: What custom software does Truestack build?
items.answer: We design and ship web apps, mobile products, internal tools, platforms, and integrations for Malaysian businesses — especially fintech and regulated operators. If your product or operating model does not fit an off-the-shelf template, we build what fits.

items.question: How does a typical engagement work?
items.answer: We start with discovery to map your idea, users, and constraints, then design and build in clear milestones you can review. After launch we stay on for support and iterations — not a one-off handoff at go-live.

items.question: Do you only build lending software?
items.answer: Lending and marketplace platforms are a core strength — TrueKredit™, TrueSyariah™, and TrueP2P™ — but we also build custom products outside lending when you need a dedicated team from brief to live. Tell us the product; we will map how we would ship it.

items.question: Where is the software hosted?
items.answer: Production builds typically run on secure cloud infrastructure in Malaysia when data residency matters. We set up solid foundations — access control, reliability, and an audit trail — so you launch with confidence.

items.question: How is this different from TrueKredit™ or TrueP2P™?
items.answer: TrueKredit™ and TrueP2P™ are ready product platforms for KPKT lending and SC-aligned P2P. Custom software development is for products that need a bespoke build. Many clients use both — a product platform plus custom modules around it.

items.question: How do I start a project?
items.answer: Book a free consultation at truestack.my/contact with the subject Custom Software. Bring the brief or the problem you need solved — we will outline scope, milestones, and what go-live looks like.
